title: Detecting GPS spoofing: hypothesis tests in the arbiter
summary: Spoofing detection as a hypothesis test: the χ² innovation of a GPS fix against vision, persistence, the jump gate's hole and the delay of a drift, a ROC curve measured by Monte Carlo. You build NAVERA Lite's spoofing guard, put it in front of your mission-29 judge, play nine attacks (one live over ROS 2), then attack your own guard.
